component.name: RRT2
component.summary: Open-source clone of Railroad Tycoon II

description.p: A modern, open-source reimplementation of the railway strategy game Railroad Tycoon II Platinum, written in Rust. The simulation is reverse-engineered from the original executable so that the mechanics stay identical to the original.

This package does not contain the original game. You need your own copy of Railroad Tycoon II (GOG, Steam or the CD install); its maps, graphics and sounds are read from your installation, which is never modified.
